source.name: State Water Resources Control Board — Beach Water Quality Monitoring Stations, from Beach Advisories (Postings and Closures) and Beach Water Quality Monitoring (data.ca.gov, ODC-By)

join_note: Stations are attached to beaches by the State Water Board's own Station_id → BeachName_id mapping, published in the same package as the beach directory. No distance or radius join is used anywhere: at South Casa Beach two stations for the same beach sit about 30 m apart and can disagree, so a nearest-station rule can report the clean one while the other is failing.

observation_join.note: A bacteria result does not carry a Station_id. The state's fecal-indicator-bacteria resource identifies its stations by 'StationCode', whose values are this table's 'Station_Name' — carried on every row below as observation_station_code. Join a result to a station on that field, never on 'id', and never on distance.
observation_join.ambiguity_consequence: These codes are each carried by two different shipped stations, so a result naming one of them cannot be attributed to a single station. Those stations are flagged observation_join_is_ambiguous and a consumer must either attribute the result to every station sharing the code or to none — never to whichever it happened to find first.
observation_join.unmatched_codes_note: The result resource also carries station codes this table does not list at all — measured 2026-09-04, 50 of them under the BeachWatch program (about 11 percent of BeachWatch rows since 2026-05-01). A result whose code names no shipped station belongs to no beach this app can name and must be dropped loudly, not attached to the nearest thing that fits.

multi_station_policy: Where a beach has more than one station the app reports the WORST reading among them and names every station it looked at. Every station row carries beach_station_count so a reader is never shown one station's result as though it were the beach's.

coverage.note: 100 of the 456 beaches in the state's directory have no monitoring station at all, and only 288 have an active one. Those beaches can never receive a water-quality reading from this source. They are listed here with has_station false, and must be shown as unmonitored — never as anything a reader could take for clean.

unmapped_stations_note: Stations whose BeachName_id names no active beach in the shipped directory. They are excluded from the join and listed here rather than dropped silently, because a station vanishing from a beach is how a beach quietly loses its worst reading.
